Frequently Asked Questions
Last Updated: Thursday, 23 April, 2026
Frequently Asked Questions
1. There are a number of websites of the Himachal Pradesh Government Departments? What is the official website to visit as authentic source of official information?

The official web portal https://himachal.nic.in/ is the only authentic source of information about the Himachal Pradesh Government and links to various Government Departments/ Boards/ Corporations/ Commissions / Autonomous Organisations/ etc.

2. Is https://himachal.nic.in and https://himachal.gov.in/ one web-portal or different?
3. Who is responsible for maintaining the official web-portal?
4. How is this web-portal different from other State Government websites?
5. How can I contribute to the Photo Gallery section as I have taken some good photos?
6. I have a grievance to lodge? How can I lodge my grievance online?
7. I find that a particular website content is obsolete. How can I get in touch with the Department concerned to get it updated?
8. My question is not listed here under FAQs. How can my query be addressed?
9. Who are the officers concerned to be contacted for different websites?
10. I have colour blindness. Can I get see this website in colour using different colour combinations?
11. I am completely blind. Is there a facility so that I can get an idea of the content available on this website?
12. Can I increase or decrease the text font of the content in this website?
13. How can I view all content available on this website in one go?
14. How can I be kept updated about the new content being made available on this website?
15. Will I be able to browse this website on my mobile?
16. Are there any useful mobile applications which I can use for accessing content of this website?
17. I live abroad. However, I have land in Himachal Pradesh. How can I view my land records through this website?
18. I found one of the links are not functional. It was giving an error. How can I get it working?
19. I found some grammatical and spelling errors in the website content? How can I get it corrected?
20. I am not good in English. Do you have website in other languages too?
21. The website colours are very bright for me. Can I change or switch this colour scheme for my comfort?
22. How can I download the telephone directory of all officials of HP Government in my mobile phone?
23. I have to deposit some money as tax into Government treasury. Can I do the transaction online using my bank account?
24. I am interested in knowing about new job opportunities whenever these are announced by any Department of Himachal Pradesh. Is there a way to get notified immediately when these are published on the website?
25. I want to register my factory with the Department of Labour & Employment? Can I do it online?
26. I want to hire employees in Himachal Pradesh for my Factory. Can I do it online by searching the eligible candidates available in Employment exchanges of the State?
27. I have a court case in District Court? Can I view orders and cause list listing of my case online?
28. I would like to see Vidhan Sabha proceedings and questions asked during Assembly sessions? Is it possible?
29. I am employee of the State Government. Where can I view my salary and GPF statements?
30. I am a State Government pensioner. Where can I download details of my pension received for Income Tax purposes?
31. Where can I view transfer orders of employees?
32. Where can I book online bus tickets?
33. I have heard that one can hold a Video conference with relatives lodged in Jails of Himachal Pradesh. However, I don’t have a computer or internet connection? How can I avail of this facility?
34. I am an elector of the Assembly and Lok Sabha. How can I find out my polling station?
35. I have to register as Elector. Can I do this online?
36. Where can I view my details as elector for the Municipal Corporations?
;

This is the official web portal of the Himachal Pradesh Government, India. The site is informative and provides links to other State Government Organizations also. The content of these websites are owned by respective organizations and they may be contacted for further information or suggestion. Neither NIC nor Government of Himachal Pradesh is liable for any inadvertent or typing errors.
